_comment: The projects page. `featured` is the top section, shown in exactly this order — reorder the entries to reorder the cards. An entry is either a repository link (`repo`: a github.com, codeberg.org or gitlab.com URL — name, description, stars, language and the project's website are read from the host) or a manual project (`name` plus any of `description`, `url`, `language`, `tags`). Any field you write on a `repo` entry overrides what the host reports. `accounts` is the bottom section: every public repository of each account, in this order. Leave a `username` empty, or remove the entry, to hide that host; an account with no public repositories is hidden too.

featured.description: This site: a prerendered React portfolio with a small TypeScript API behind its live cards.
